Able was I ere I saw Elba. How vexingly quick daft geese saw my sad little elf! Was it a car or a cat I saw? No, a red racecar went mad and a civic cab drove in. Did Hannah's mom sell her a phone? Yes, I did. 

Now for a longer one:

A man, a plan, a canal, Panama; no lemon, no melon. How I wish I could travel around the world with my dog. Did you see that car racecar race me into victory? No, I didn't. But my civic car drove in and I saw a radar reading radar, so I was happy. 

Able was I ere I saw Elba. Was it a car or a cat I saw? A man, a plan, a canal, Panama; no lemon, no melon. How vexingly quick daft geese saw my sad little elf! Was I mad as a hatter? Yes, I was. But I'm glad to be alive and happy, so let's race!
